question: Do occupation-law fixtures cover the probability structures relevant to full-density Lorenz posterior forecasting?
hypotheses: Occupation laws are legitimate engineering fixtures but their application representativeness is unverified
Conditioning can create concentration/lobe-weight structures not adequately represented by six occupation laws
Reconstruction variation can obscure law-family differences; measure it without claiming G02/G03 certification
metrics: initial reconstruction versus accepted FE voxels

thresholds.mass_rationale: Reuse existing pilot numerical mass tolerance for representation sanity only; no population-coverage inference
thresholds.technical_completion: All required families and all frozen comparisons recorded with finite nonnegative normalized densities and complete metadata
thresholds.scientific_pass: Owner approves a named intended population, explicit generator roles and exclusions after reviewing the frozen evidence. No numerical coverage threshold inferred from results.
thresholds.separation_diagnostic: Report whether within-law replicate L1 is smaller than law-conditioning L1. This comparison is heuristic, not an acceptance threshold or confidence interval.

required_evidence: scoped population recommendation and owner approval record
pass_consequences: Only OL-G01 representation study becomes eligible; no training, target campaign, posterior-transfer certification or DA authorization.
failure_consequences: Preserve evidence and G00 OPEN/FAILED as appropriate. Revise population or predeclare a new comparison; no gate relaxation.
review_requirements: Owner approval of actual population recommendation is required; execution approval is not invented outcome approval
observation_basis: Existing ObservationModel.named maps x/xz/full and default variance 4; variance16 is a declared weaker-observation stress choice seen in mature experiments, not an application requirement.
limitations: Six historical source groups and two replicates are illustrative, not population coverage or uncertainty certification
Circular block length50 is a diagnostic design choice, not proven decorrelation time; G02 remains open
SDE Euler-Maruyama discretization and finite particle/reconstruction bias are unqualified; no continuum reference claim
Whole-space SDE particles have no reflection; zero observed exits does not prove domain equivalence
Conditioned density is a posterior for the explicitly regularized, piecewise-constant voxel prior; not a certified continuum or sequential filtering posterior
No FE projection or FPE targets generated for new families; G01/G04 required later
All generated examples and original pilot test are development evidence, never untouched final evaluation
forbidden_claims: Reference targets qualified for new families
